title: Magflow: Differentiable Simulation of Industrial-Grade 6D Magnetic Levitation
abstract: arXiv:2611.23050v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Magnetic levitation with six-degrees-of-freedom enables frictionless transport and micrometer-scale positioning in principle, but low-level control is inherently challenging due to its complex and unstable dynamics. Industrial systems typically rely on deep hardware-software co-design, where mover and stator geometries are jointly designed to enable a compact, hand-crafted approximation of the electromagnetic force computation, thereby keeping control computationally tractable at kilohertz rates. However, this approach imposes overly conservative constraints on the operating workspace and the range of supported mover topologies. Instead of reducing the underlying physics to a hand-crafted approximation, we compute the physics directly. We introduce Magflow, a fully differentiable, GPU-parallel simulator for 6D magnetic levitation. translated_title: Magflow：工业级六自由度磁悬浮的可微仿真
translated_abstract: 具有六自由度的磁悬浮系统原则上能够实现无摩擦运输和微米级定位，但由于其复杂且不稳定的动力学特性，底层控制本质上极具挑战性。工业系统通常依赖深度的软硬件协同设计，即动子与定子的几何结构被联合设计，以实现对电磁力计算的紧凑手工近似，从而使控制算法能够在千赫兹频率下保持计算上的可行性。然而，这种方法对工作空间范围以及所支持的动子拓扑类型施加了过于保守的限制。我们不再将底层物理简化为手工近似，而是直接计算物理本身。我们提出了Magflow，一个完全可微、GPU并行的六自由度磁悬浮仿真器。该仿真器被用于训练首个面向工业级六自由度磁悬浮系统的神经控制器
tldr: 提出了首个完全可微、GPU并行的六自由度磁悬浮仿真器Magflow，并利用它训练出首个工业级六自由度磁悬浮系统的神经控制器，突破了传统手工近似电磁力计算方法对工作空间和动子拓扑的保守限制。
en_tdlr: Magflow, a fully differentiable GPU-parallel simulator for 6D magnetic levitation, enables training of the first neural controller for an industrial-grade 6D maglev system, overcoming the conservative constraints of hand-crafted electromagnetic force approximations.
